about: the bodies (engine/src/corpses.rs) under the Original preset: courtyard's fight (warp before lev_1_m1's courtyard guards, rifle and stickies) traced to 12 s, so the first deaths' bodies are removed in both games. Checked: corpse.ragdoll (a ragdoll's whole lying time, 5 s in the original: Character_GoRagdoll 0x00431310, Corpse_CountDown 0x0042eba0), corpse.anim (an animated death's rest after its death anim, 0.5 s: 0x00427100, state 0x191), corpse.removed. The fight plays out by each game's AI rolls (which grunt dies when, and how), so the AI and Roman families are known differences here; bodies are compared per grunt that died the same way in both
